# clipboard

Wayland clipboard utilities (`wl-clipboard`) and persistence after the source app quits (`wl-clip-persist`).

Clipboard history (`super+v`) is served by [walker](walker.md) through Elephant's `clipboard` provider (`walker -m clipboard`, with image previews, `Ctrl+D` delete and `Ctrl+Shift+D` wipe); `wl-clip-persist.service` keeps the active clipboard selection alive after the copying window closes.

## Reference
